blocks.text: Elements ko mote taur par teen qismon mein baanta ja sakta hai: metals, non-metals aur metalloids. Metals woh elements hain jo electrons kho kar positive ions banate hain, jaise iron, copper, gold aur silver. Doosri taraf non-metals woh elements hain jo electrons le kar negative ions banate hain, jaise chlorine, sulfur aur phosphorus. Metalloids periodic table par metals aur non-metals ko alag karte hain. Metalloids mein kuch properties metals jaisi aur kuch non-metals jaisi hoti hain.

Aksar periodic tables par ek “stair-step line” (seerhi jaisi lakeer) hoti hai jo in groups ki pehchan karati hai. Yeh line boron (B) se shuru ho kar neeche polonium (Po) tak jati hai, aur Si, Ge, As, Sb aur Te is ke saath hain. Line ke baen (left) wale elements metals hain. Line ke bilkul daen (right) wale elements mein metals aur non-metals dono ki properties hoti hain; inhein metalloids ya semimetals kehte hain. Table ke bilkul daen kinare wale elements non-metals hain. Is qaide se hat kar (exception) hydrogen hai, jo table ka pehla element hai.

blocks.alt: Jadeed periodic table: 118 anasir (elements), 7 periods aur 18 groups mein. Har khaane mein atomic number, symbol, naam aur average atomic mass hai (namoona: Pt, platinum, 78, 195.1). Rang batate hain: alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, transition metals, other metals, metalloids, non-metals, halogens aur noble gases; lanthanides (57-71) aur actinides (89-103) neeche do qataaron mein hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1: Jadeed periodic table (kitab ki Figure 1.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Groups 1 se 18 baayen se daayen aur periods 1 se 7 upar se neeche hain. Group 1 mein hydrogen aur alkali metals, group 2 mein alkaline earth metals, groups 3 se 12 mein transition metals, aur groups 13 se 18 mein other metals, metalloids, non-metals, halogens (group 17) aur noble gases (group 18) hain. Group 3 ke 57-71 aur 89-103 wale khaane lanthanides aur actinides ke liye hain jo table ke neeche alag do qataaron mein chhape hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pt (platinum) wala namoona dekhein: khaane ke oopar atomic number (78), beech mein bara symbol (Pt), neeche naam aur average atomic mass (195.1). Har element ka khaana isi tarah bana hai. Rang batata hai ke element kis qism ka hai: alkali metal, alkaline earth metal, transition metal, other metal, metalloid, non-metal, halogen ya noble gas. Stair-step line boron (B) se polonium (Po) tak grey metalloids ke kinare chalti hai. Helium ki configuration 1s² hai, phir bhi use noble gases ke saath group 18 mein rakha jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Hydrogen table ke oopar baen taraf hai, jahan metals hote hain. Phir use exception kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Stair-step line ke baen wale sab elements metals gine jate hain, lekin hydrogen, jo pehla element hai, non-metal hai. Yeh neeche wale alkali metals ki tarah electron khone ke bajaye electron leta ya share karta hai, is liye qaide ka exception hai.

items: Metals electrons khote hain (positive ions), non-metals electrons lete hain (negative ions), metalloids mein dono ki properties hain.
Boron se polonium tak stair-step line (Si, Ge, As, Sb, Te) metals ko non-metals se alag karti hai; hydrogen exception hai.
